title: Japan Cultural Tales | Group Tour Package
highlights: Soak in Japan's rich culture and history, from ancient temples and traditional gardens to bustling cities and breathtaking landscapes.
Explore Shinjuku District, a vibrant hub of Tokyo known for its towering skyscrapers, bustling shopping streets, and lively nightlife.
Discover Nara, home to ancient temples and friendly deer, offering a serene glimpse into Japan's historic past and natural beauty.
Stroll through Korakuen Gardens, a beautifully landscaped park featuring beautiful ponds, seasonal flowers, and traditional Japanese design.
Visit the Hiroshima Peace Memorial, a renowned site dedicated to peace and remembrance, offering profound insights into the city’s enduring spirit.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel
2 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast
1 night stay in Kyoto with breakfast
1 night stay in Osaka with breakfast
1 night stay in Okayama with breakfast
1 night stay in Hiroshima with breakfast
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage to any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. The travelers will be accommodated at a property of a similar standard if they are unavailable.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Japan, "the Land of the Rising Sun!" After arriving at Narita International Airport, get transferred to your hotel. After checking in, board the metro (tickets included) to Shinjuku District. Experience the bustling streets of Shinjuku District. You can visit Shinjuku Gyoen. Next, you can explore Golden Gai's vibrant bars, and discover many more such attractions. Later, return to your hotel by metro (tickets included) for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Tokyo, a vibrant city known for its dazzling neon lights. During this day trip, explore Zojoji Temple, offering views of Tokyo Tower. Next, get driven to Shibuya Crossing, known for being the world's most crowded junction, and visit the Meiji Shrine. Travel along Omotesando Street, taking in the view of the Imperial Palace, and then visit Sensoji Temple in Asakusa, Nijubashi Bridge, and other attractions. Afterward, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time in Gion
days.desc: Check out of your hotel and board the Bullet Train (tickets included) from Tokyo to Kyoto. Then, head to the hotel and check-in. Afterward, start your city exploration with visits to the beautiful Fushimi Inari Shrine, the Imperial Palace, and Kinkakuji Temple, famously known as the "Golden Pavilion." Then, get transferred to Gion, renowned for geisha performers, where you can visit Yosaka Shrine and Kenninji Temple. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at Super Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: The Prince Kyoto Takaragaike, Autograph Collection

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | En-route Visit Nara
days.desc: Depart from Kyoto and get transferred to Osaka. En route, visit Nara, where you can witness deer that wander the park. Next, visit Todaiji, a magnificent Buddhist temple with a giant Buddha. Then, explore Horyuji, a World Heritage Site and the oldest Buddhist temple in Japan. Upon arrival in Osaka, check into your hotel and spend your day at leisure. Then get transferred to the Dotonbori District, filled with options to enjoy nightlife. Return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: Holiday Inn Express Osaka City Centre - Midosuji, an IHG Hotel

days.title: Transfer to Okayama | En Route Visit Himeji Castle | Okayama Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check out, get transferred to Okayama. En route, enjoy the panoramic views of Himeji Castle, famous for its Japanese architecture. Afterward, get driven to Okayama, check in, and get transferred to explore Korakuen, one of Japan's most beautiful gardens. Visit the Shinto shrine of Kibitsu-Jinja, known for its unique 360-meter corridor and the legend of Momotaro. Later, you can explore the city at your own pace. Then, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | En-route Visit Kurashiki | Hiroshima Walking Tour | Visit to Itsukushima Shrine
days.desc: After check out, get transferred to Hiroshima. En route, enjoy a stop at Kurashiki to spend your leisure time in its historical center. Continue towards Hiroshima and upon arriving, visit Hiroshima's Peace Memorial Museum and Park, along with the Atomic Bomb Dome. Then, get transferred to Miyajimaguchi Ferry Terminal for a ferry ride to Miyajima Island. Explore the beautiful Itsukushima Shrine and its vermillion torii gates. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Pack your bags full of memorable adventures and cherish every moment spent here. Check out of your hotel in the morning and board your flight back home. Here, your trip to Japan comes to an end.
